output.headline: Blackstone pays the highest median multiple on the priority list and has already bought in the Midwest in the target's own sub-sector.
output.differentiator: Blackstone's median multiple paid of 17.1x is the highest on the priority list, and it has already done a Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector (Peak Medical Management). [T:record, D:MA-2021-0407]
output.why_them: Pays top multiples; Midwest precedent in the target's own sub-sector

acquirer_overview.title: Blackstone: large financial sponsor with a ten-year, 25-deal record
points: Blackstone is a financial sponsor with 25 deals between 2015 and 2024; 22 closed (88%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
Blackstone's record is mostly control deals: 7 Leveraged Buyouts, 5 Bolt-on Acquisitions and 4 Platform Investments; 23 of 25 are control deals [T:record, K:control_share].
Blackstone's Private Equity segment holds $416.4 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025 [P:1].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Two own-sub-sector deals and seven adjacent provider deals support the fit
points: For Blackstone, sub-sector relevance and number of past deals are each a modest factor in its likelihood; deal size within its usual range is a slight positive [S:sector_rel, S:activity, S:not_smaller].
Platform Build is a stated motive in 9 of 25 Blackstone deals, above the 23% share across all deals in the file [M:platform_build].
Regional record is a slight negative, and Blackstone has no open platform in the sub-sector to add this target onto [S:geo_fit, A:angles].

precedent_activity.title: Four relevant Blackstone precedents, two in the target's own sub-sector
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, 10.0x EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2021-0407].
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, Southwest, 14.6x EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2021-0195].
Dental, both 2021: Crest Oral Health, $558M Leveraged Buyout at 13.5x; North Smile Group, $222M Management Buyout at 13.5x [D:MA-2021-0164, D:MA-2021-0453].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but Blackstone's return at the ask falls short
points: 70 comparable deals span 10.7x to 15.3x EBITDA, median 12.8x. The target's 16.8% margin versus the comps' 12.9% median supports the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Blackstone's own median multiple paid is 17.1x, above the 15.3x upper quartile of the comparable range [V:comps, T:record].
At 5.0x leverage Blackstone's equity cheque is $128M; IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: Blackstone's IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below its 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit the maximum is $193M, so the bid needs the platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest record
risk_flags.concern: Prior regional buying is a slight factor against; only 2 Blackstone deals are in the target's region [S:geo_fit, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: One of those is Peak Medical Management, a $342M Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0407].
risk_flags.reality: Regional fit is a slight negative, not a barrier [S:geo_fit].

risk_flags.title: No open platform, broad focus
risk_flags.concern: Blackstone has no open platform in the sub-sector, and 16 of its 25 deals are outside provider services [A:angles, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: It has 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Blackstone would likely approach this as a standalone bid, not an add-on [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: Based on Blackstone's 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, offset by no open platform in the sub-sector. Likelihood is 4.3%, 9th overall of 107 buyers scored [C:conviction, R:rank].
